points.description: Setup: the new (unlabelled) data point is placed into the space/set of existing labelled (classified/coloured) data, and the k nearest labelled points (neighbours, by a distance measure) are selected/identified around it. Equivalent wording or pseudocode accepted.

Voting and assignment: count the classes/colours among the k neighbours, pick the class with the maximum votes (majority), and assign the new data point to that class. Equivalent wording or pseudocode accepted.
